frozen_against: SlimX-RAG 7e802dcbc1366bdc5b6e1285b63455c957036a56 (the candidate after the same-model reviews), owner decision 2026-09-26: ControlRoom's title convention (every document titled by its upload filename) is a second, mandatory qualification gate beside quality-gate.json, which stays unchanged as the historical gate.
policy: Every threshold is copied unchanged from quality-gate.json and may not be lowered after seeing post-change results without explicit owner authorization. A candidate must pass this gate AND quality-gate.json. The report must come from --title-mode filename and evaluator version 2 (stale text tied to the revised document's identity); a report from another regime or evaluator fails the title_mode / evaluator_version check.

rationale.title_mode / evaluator_version: The regime this gate was frozen for: ControlRoom sends the upload filename as the document title (routes_documents), so the product-facing regime must pass, not only the benchmark's human titles; evaluator 2 counts lifecycle stale text in the revised document's own chunks only (RAG-AUD-045, owner-authorized).
rationale.hard.cross_*_leaks / forbidden_document_: Workspace, project (explicit document set) and explicit document restriction are security boundaries; any leak is a release blocker (handoff section 12).
rationale.hard.stale_deleted_hits / chunks_listed_: A document ControlRoom deleted must not be served again, even when a lagging host scope still names its id.
rationale.hard.updated_doc_stale_hits / forbidden_: Re-indexing a document id replaces its content; old text must never be returned.
rationale.hard.citation_wrong_source / citation_wr: Citation fidelity: every returned chunk is attributed to the document, page (PDF) and heading (Markdown/DOCX) that actually holds its text, and the label agrees with the metadata (verified against the corpus bytes, independent of ranking).
rationale.hard.unstable_cases / restart_inconsiste: Retrieval must be deterministic across identical calls and across a service restart (the persisted index is the truth).
rationale.hard[hf].updated_doc_missing_new_content: After re-indexing, the new content must be retrievable for its direct question; otherwise updates silently vanish from the product.
rationale.hard[hf].expected_locator_failures: For the citation-fidelity gold cases (unambiguous page/section questions) the best result from the right document must carry the gold page or section; a wrong or absent locator is a wrong citation to the reader (handoff section 12: 0 in required citation-fidelity cases).
rationale.ranking.hit_at_5 >= 0.95: ControlRoom packs about five to eight chunks into the prompt; the source of an answerable gold question must be among them at least 95% of the time.
rationale.ranking.hit_at_1 >= 0.85, mrr >= 0.88, n: The first passage the model reads should usually be the right one; these bound the average rank of the right source without demanding perfection on paraphrase and semantic questions.
rationale.ranking.exact_identifier_hit_at_1 >= 0.9: Part numbers, report ids, tags and constants are the precise lookups engineering users depend on; the first hit must be right in at least 19 of 20 cases.
rationale.ranking.top1_expected_source_rate >= 0.9: For questions with one unambiguous source, the top result must come from it (at most 3 misses in the 46 tagged cases).
rationale.ranking.multi_doc_coverage_at_8 >= 0.9: Comparison and multi-source questions must surface every required document within the eight returned chunks.
